In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.title: Portugal vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Portugal vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news. **Portugal and Norway are set to meet again on Sunday in their fourth UEFA Nations League group-stage clash, which also marks the final fixture for both sides during this international window.**. Most recently, they produced an impressive attacking display to beat Denmark 4-2, reinforcing their place at the summit of the group table. ## Portugal team news. Gonçalo Ramos has stepped up effectively, scoring in back-to-back matches, while João Félix is in outstanding form, netting in all three of Portugal's Nations League fixtures this term. The main fitness doubt for the hosts involves winger Francisco Conceição, who is still managing a lingering thigh issue and will undergo a late assessment before kick-off. ## When will the match kick off? The match will kick off at 7:45pm BST on Sunday, 4th October. In the United Kingdom, the Portugal vs Norway encounter will be shown live on Amazon Prime Video on a pay-per-view (PPV) basis.
